definitions.coverage_90: fraction of targets inside the reported 90 percent interval
definitions.coverage_95: fraction of targets inside the reported 95 percent interval

interval_construction.sigma_source: sealed prediction file; sigma is never reconstructed from truth or from rounded intervals

no_minimum_scientific_threshold: Engineering success is protocol integrity. A poor scientific result is reported, never dropped.
post_hoc_rule: No metric may be added after scoring and then described as preregistered. Additional analyses are allowed only when labelled POST_HOC.
